title: Business Development Manager – Renewable Energy
desc:
As Entek Elektrik, a company within Koç Holding's energy division and a key player in the energy sector, we have been active in every stage of the sector's value chain since we began our operations in 1995. With the vision of becoming a pioneering next-generation company in the energy sector, we continue to invest in both domestic and international renewable energy sources while advancing new technologies in the industry. In line with this vision, we generate electricity through our 11 power plants.
In addition to playing a critical role in advancing Koç Group's green energy goals, Entek operates with the sense of responsibility that comes with being a leader in Turkey's renewable energy sector. You too can be part of Entek's inspiring journey, as we follow our ambitious roadmap to achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Master’s degree is considered an asset.
6 - 8 years of relevant experience in business development, project development, investment analysis, or renewable energy markets.
Hands-on experience in renewable energy investments, preferably including wind and solar projects, greenfield development, acquisitions, or strategic partnerships.
International business or project experience, preferably within European energy markets.
Strong understanding of energy markets, regulatory frameworks, incentive mechanisms, and competitive dynamics.
Experience in technical, commercial, financial, legal, tax, environmental, or strategic due diligence processes is an advantage.
Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Willingness and flexibility to travel internationally when required.
Responsibilities
Identify and assess renewable energy investment and growth opportunities in line with Entek’s strategic priorities, with a particular focus on international markets and Europe.
Conduct market research, sector analysis, and market-entry assessments to identify attractive geographies, technologies, and business opportunities.
Evaluate investment opportunities from technical, commercial, financial, regulatory, and strategic perspectives.
Develop business cases, investment analyses, management presentations, and strategic recommendations to support decision-making.
Contribute actively to the assessment, development, acquisition, and partnership processes of renewable energy projects.
Monitor energy market developments, regulatory changes, incentive schemes, and competitive dynamics across target markets.
Coordinate multidisciplinary due diligence processes, including technical, commercial, legal, financial, tax, and environmental workstreams.
Manage collaboration with external consultants, advisors, project developers, and other business partners throughout investment evaluation processes.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with relevant internal teams during business development, investment assessment, and project execution stages.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across target markets.
Support the preparation and monitoring of project budgets, timelines, and investment plans.
By joining us;
We operate in the fast-evolving and growing energy sector. By joining Entek, a dynamic and expanding company in the sector, you can gain diverse experiences.
You can network within the Koç Group and participate in various working groups.
You can benefit from the unlimited and free "Koç Group Exclusive Healthy Living Program" service offered by Koç Healthcare.
You will have continuous learning and development opportunities through technical, leadership, and personal development training programs, which are industry-leading and help you specialize in your field.
By participating in agile projects that align with your interests, you can get to know various functions and develop different competencies.
You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic, diverse, collaborative, talented, and high-performing team.
You can benefit from individual mentoring and consultancy support with our development tools.
We care about the mental and physical well-being of our employees. You can take advantage of our online psychologist and dietitian services.
We provide our colleagues a hybrid working model and flexible working hours.
